summary.text: Book a phone appointment at a time that suits you, or book a visit to a CPF Service Centre for help in person.

details.heading: Employers and self-employed
details.body: Use CPF digital services, the hotline, Write to us or a phone appointment. In-person appointments are not available for these matters.

example_phrasings: I want to go to the CPF office to ask something
how to make an appointment with CPF
can CPF officer call me at a fixed time

sources.page_title: How do I make an appointment with CPF?

quotes.text: You can book a phone appointment to speak with a Customer Service Executive at your preferred time.
For matters that require in-person assistance, you can make an appointment to visit any of our Service Centres.
For employer or self-employed matters, assistance is available through our digital services, hotline, Write to us or phone appointment. In-person appointments are not available for these matters.
